summary: Tested iteration 216u — Phase 2 PPM Auto-gen & AI Auto-assign. All 12 backend tests pass. Fixed bug in /api/svc/scheduler/auto-assign endpoint that was missing 'reason' field in rankings. Frontend Service Desk verified: 'Suggest: <name>' with sparkles icon renders correctly for unassigned cases with recommendations.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: scheduler.py auto-assign endpoint was using _score() directly instead of _score_engineers_for_case(), causing 'reason' field to be missing from rankings. Now uses the shared helper.
intake.py:213-235 — correctly calls _score_engineers_for_case and stamps recommended_engineer_id/name/score/reason on new cases
ppm_autogen.py:33-136 — run_ppm_autogen_cycle() correctly spawns svc_cases from due ppm_tasks with LOOKAHEAD_DAYS=14
sicon_poller.py:258-264 — _run_ppm_autogen() correctly wired into poll cycle after _run_family_autopay()
ServiceDeskPage.js:244-259 — engineer column correctly renders: assigned name (no sparkles), 'Suggest: <name>' with sparkles for recommendations, 'unassigned' for no recommendation
ServiceDeskPage.js:250-251 — title attribute shows recommended_engineer_reason on hover, data-testid='case-recommended-{reference}' for testing
seed_data_creation: Created 10+ test cases with TEST_ prefix via backend tests: TEST_Phase2_AutoAssign_Phone, TEST_Phase2_AutoAssign_Email, TEST_Phase2_AutoAssign_Portal, TEST_Phase2_Persist_Check, TEST_ListCases_Recommended, TEST_AutoAssign_Reason, TEST_AutoAssign_Commit, TEST_Reason_Format
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 PPM auto-gen and AI auto-assign features are working. Key changes: (1) POST /api/svc/intake/* now stamps recommended_engineer_id/name/score/reason on every new case when active engineers exist, (2) GET /api/svc/cases returns these fields, (3) POST /api/svc/scheduler/auto-assign now returns 'reason' field in rankings (bug fixed), (4) PPM autogen cycle spawns svc_cases from due ppm_tasks within 14-day lookahead, (5) Frontend Service Desk shows 'Suggest: <name>' with sparkles icon for unassigned cases with recommendations.

backend_intake_recommended_fields.evidence: POST /api/svc/intake/phone returns recommended_engineer_id, recommended_engineer_name, recommended_engineer_score, recommended_engineer_reason

backend_list_cases_recommended_fields.evidence: GET /api/svc/cases returns recommended_engineer_* fields, no _id leakage

backend_auto_assign_reason_field.evidence: POST /api/svc/scheduler/auto-assign returns rankings with 'reason' field (BUG FIXED)

frontend_suggest_sparkles.evidence: Screenshot shows 'Suggest: Master Admin' with sparkles icon in Engineer column for unassigned cases with recommendations

frontend_assigned_no_sparkles.evidence: Screenshot shows 'Master Admin' (no sparkles) for manually assigned cases

frontend_unassigned_label.evidence: Screenshot shows 'unassigned' for cases without recommendations

bug_fixed.issue: Rankings were missing 'reason' field because endpoint used _score() directly instead of _score_engineers_for_case()
bug_fixed.fix: Changed auto_assign() to use _score_engineers_for_case() helper which adds the human-readable 'reason' field
